title: Nicolas Raince to Montmorency, Rome, 13 May and 20 Nov 1526, BnF fr. 2984 pp. 29-31 and p. 105

plaintext.source: Later gloss on the first c. 13 lines of p. 29 and c. 12 lines of p. 105; the rest unread anywhere found

transcription.source: Gallica microfilm btv1b90598430; connected-component segmentation clustered to 70 classes, then hand-read glyph by glyph on numbered-token images
transcription.notes: Counted by splitting raince_cipher.txt on ';' (the --measure tool reads each semicolon line as one token); distinct = 70 clusters, not true glyph types. 106 lines of about 50 glyphs.

system.summary: Monoalphabetic substitution in graphic signs with homophones for a e i o r u, three nulls and three word-signs (con, l'empereur, le pape).
system.sibling_key: Tomokiyo's published 1526 key (same key serves fr. 3040 f. 21) used directly; his 1529 key is a different key
system.notes: One glyph (bold stem with two crossbars, ten occurrences at clause boundaries) is in no published table.

prior_solution.where: Key published by Tomokiyo 2020 without plaintext; partial glosses on the leaves; other letters of the volume read by Mignet 1886 and Bourrilly 1901

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Tomokiyo's keys, DECODE records, Mignet 1886 and Bourrilly 1901 located; unread residue isolated to pp. 29-31 and p. 105.
Tomokiyo's key table read by eye; l, m, n shifted one column.
Blind cluster-to-letter solver in session 1 collapses to a degenerate map.
Key re-measured programmatically off the image; control line resolves glyph for glyph.
Shape-constrained hill-climb over 70/140 clusters with a 6-gram LM gives draft5, about 86 % of letters right.
86 of 106 lines read glyph by glyph against numbered-token images; 20 lines left with a machine decode only.

outcome.notes: 86 of about 106 lines hand-read (reading.txt marks H/M lines, not the H/C/M/I grades). Limit is microfilm resolution and segmentation. fraction_read 0.75 is an estimate from the notes (86 of 106 lines hand-read, draft about 86% right per letter), not a token count. fraction_read 0.75 is an estimate from the notes (86 of 106 lines hand-read, draft about 86% right per letter), not a token count.

gaps.item: 13 May 1526 letter, pp. 29-31 (96 lines): residual letter errors and ~20 machine-only lines
gaps.detail: B/W Gallica microfilm; LOO classifier accuracy saturates at 0.868 as hand labels are added, the e/r, t/l/d, s/u/a confusions are resolution-bound; better photographs of pp. 29-31 needed

gaps.item: 20 Nov 1526 letter, lower 21-28 lines of p. 105
gaps.detail: same microfilm limit; only line 4 verified glyph by glyph

gaps.item: one-glyph word sign, bold stem with two crossbars, p. 30 line 1
gaps.detail: matches nothing in Tomokiyo's table; single occurrence
